note: The v4 simulated world is built by ten_layer_detector/world_v4.py: four platform classes (multirotor_hover, multirotor_maneuver, fixed_wing, large_slow), realistic IMU, ionosphere, multipath; attackers half ordinary and half matched-power with preserved clock and reproduced ionosphere (session ids contain _m_ for matched). Results from sim_v4 are never mixed with sim_v3 in one table without a note. All values are simulated assumptions.

sim_v4_fahold.use: clean-only hold-out for checking false-alarm rates during choices; never used to fit or calibrate

sim_v4_test.use: fresh test, opened once for the locked configuration
